description: A panel that shows the maker's own description of whatever MADZINE control the mouse is resting on, in English, Chinese or Japanese
notes: this module has no jacks and no knobs. Move the cursor over a knob, a jack or the bare panel of any MADZINE module and its text appears here.
with the cursor away from any MADZINE module the panel goes back to its instruction line.
the text comes from the maker's own help file built into the plugin, matched by the control's name, and falls back to the module's one-line description where that control has no entry.
the small pill at the top cycles the language between EN, ZH and JA on each click, and the A- and A+ buttons beside it change the body text size between 8 and 32 points in steps of 2.
the module shows nothing for itself; resting the cursor on this panel leaves the instruction line in place.
